title.zh: Anthropic 计划在 AI 基础设施上投入 5180 亿美元。IPO 前永续合约几乎毫无反应。
title.en: Anthropic plans to spend $518 billion on AI infrastructure. Pre-IPO perps barely blink.

current_state.zh: Anthropic 的机密 IPO 文件据报显示：计划投入约 5180 亿美元于 AI 基础设施/算力承诺，目标估值超过 2 万亿美元，2025 年净亏损约 420 亿美元、经营亏损 80.6 亿美元、营收 45.9 亿美元；创始人通过特殊结构保留控制权；内部警告先进 AI 可能抵抗关机；算力承诺涉及 Google、Amazon、Microsoft、Broadcom，以及最高 845 亿美元的 xAI Nvidia 算力协议和 AMD 超过 200 亿美元算力安排；上市预计在 11 月美国中期选举后推进。
current_state.en: Anthropic's confidential IPO filing reportedly shows plans to commit roughly $518 billion to AI infrastructure/compute, a target valuation above $2 trillion, a ~$42 billion net loss, $8.06 billion operating loss, and $4.59 billion in 2025 revenue; founders retain control through a special structure; internal warnings say advanced AI could resist shutdown attempts; compute commitments involve Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Broadcom, an xAI Nvidia compute agreement worth up to $84.5 billion, and an AMD arrangement exceeding $20 billion; the listing is expected after the November US midterm elections.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic 在其 IPO 文件中警告 AI 存在“灾难性”风险
updates.title_en: Anthropic warns of ‘catastrophic’ AI risks in its own IPO filing
updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 文件预览还披露了约 2 万亿美元估值目标、领导层保留控制权的提议，以及内部警告称其 AI 开发可能增加模型造成伤害的风险。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic's IPO filing preview also reportedly discloses an ambitious ~$2 trillion valuation target, proposals for leadership to retain control, and internal warnings that its AI development could increase the risk of model-caused harm.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 文件据报显示计划在 AI 基础设施上投入 5180 亿美元，同时存在严重亏损；文件还提到约 2 万亿美元估值目标、领导层保留控制权提议，以及内部警告称 AI 开发可能增加模型造成伤害的风险。交易所上的 pre-IPO 永续合约价格反应极小。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic's IPO filing reportedly shows plans to spend $518 billion on AI infrastructure despite heavy losses; it also reportedly includes an ambitious ~$2 trillion valuation target, proposals for leadership to retain control, and internal warnings that AI development could increase the risk of model-caused harm. Pre-IPO perpetual futures on crypto exchanges showed minimal price reaction.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic's forthcoming IPO filing reportedly discloses heavy losses, proposals for leadership to retain control, an ambitious ~$2 trillion valuation target, and internal warnings that its AI development could increase the risk of model-caused harm.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic's forthcoming IPO filing reportedly discloses heavy losses, proposals for leadership to retain control, an ambitious ~$2 trillion valuation target, and internal warnings that its AI development could increase the risk of model-caused harm.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic披露与SpaceX签署高达845亿美元算力协议
updates.title_en: Anthropic披露与SpaceX签署高达845亿美元算力协议
updates.what_changed_zh: Anthropic 在机密 IPO 文件中披露与 SpaceX 签署协议，计划到 2029 年前支付最高 845 亿美元，使用 SpaceX 基于英伟达芯片的 AI 计算资源，且大多可提前 90 天通知终止。
updates.what_changed_en: Anthropic disclosed in its confidential IPO filing an agreement to pay SpaceX up to $84.5 billion through 2029 for access to SpaceX's Nvidia-based AI compute, with most commitments terminable on 90 days' notice.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 文件据报显示计划在 AI 基础设施上投入 5180 亿美元且存在严重亏损，并包含约 2 万亿美元估值目标、领导层保留控制权提议、内部风险警告，以及与 SpaceX 高达 845 亿美元的算力协议。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic's IPO filing reportedly shows plans to spend $518 billion on AI infrastructure despite heavy losses, and includes an ambitious ~$2 trillion valuation target, proposals for leadership to retain control, internal risk warnings, and an agreement with SpaceX worth up to $84.5 billion.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic disclosed in its confidential IPO filing an agreement to pay SpaceX up to $84.5B through 2029 for access to SpaceX's Nvidia-based AI compute, with most commitments terminable on 90 days' notice.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic disclosed in its confidential IPO filing an agreement to pay SpaceX up to $84.5B through 2029 for access to SpaceX's Nvidia-based AI compute, with most commitments terminable on 90 days' notice.

updates.title_zh: Anthropic 亏损 420 亿美元，警告 AI 可能抗拒关停，但交易员仍将其估值定在 2 万亿美元
updates.title_en: Anthropic lost $42 billion, warned AI could resist shutdowns, but traders still price it at $2 trillion
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充了 Anthropic 机密 IPO 文件中的具体财务数据：2025 年净亏损约 420 亿美元、经营亏损 80.6 亿美元、营收 45.9 亿美元，两大直接客户各贡献 12% 收入；并列出对 Google、Amazon、Microsoft、Broadcom 以及 xAI/AMD 的算力承诺细节，同时称上市预计在 11 月美国中期选举后推进。
updates.what_changed_en: The new report adds specific financial details from Anthropic's confidential IPO filing: a ~$42 billion net loss, $8.06 billion operating loss, $4.59 billion in 2025 revenue, and two direct customers each generating 12% of sales; it also details compute commitments to Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Broadcom, and xAI/AMD, and says the listing is expected after the November US midterm elections.
